title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta until crispy.
Beat eggs with grated cheese and black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving some pasta water.
Mix hot pasta with pancetta, then quickly stir in egg mixture.
Add pasta water if needed to create creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka paste for 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until cooked through.
In a separate pan, sauté onions, garlic, and ginger in butter.
Add tomatoes and cook until sauce thickens.
Blend sauce until smooth, return to pan.
Add cream and cooked chicken, simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
summary: Quick and healthy vegetable stir fry with soy-ginger sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in wok or large pan over high heat.
Add carrots and broccoli, stir fry for 3 minutes.
Add bell peppers and onion, cook for another 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic.
Pour sauce over vegetables, toss to coat.
Cook for 2 more minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

title: Chocolate Lava Cake
summary: Decadent chocolate cake with a molten chocolate center.
ingredients: Butter and cocoa powder for ramekins
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F).
Butter and cocoa powder 4 ramekins.
Melt chocolate and butter together, let cool slightly.
Whisk eggs, yolks, and sugar until pale and thick.
Fold in melted chocolate mixture.
Sift in flour and salt, fold gently.
Divide batter among ramekins.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until edges set but center soft.
Let rest 1 minute, then invert onto plates and serve.

title: Greek Salad
summary: Fresh Mediterranean salad with feta cheese and olives.
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and bell pepper in large bowl.
Add feta cheese and olives.
Whisk together olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently.
Let marinate for 15 minutes before serving.
Garnish with extra oregano if desired.

title: Beef Bourguignon
summary: French beef stew braised in red wine with vegetables.
instructions: Brown beef in batches, set aside.
Cook bacon until crispy, remove.
Sauté carrots, onion, and garlic in bacon fat.
Add tomato paste, cook for 1 minute.
Return beef and bacon to pot.
Add wine, broth, thyme, and bay leaves.
Simmer covered for 2 hours.
Add mushrooms, cook for 30 more minutes.
Season and serve with mashed potatoes.
